_about: The story engine's slow world. drift: how place numbers (prosperity and safety 0 to 100, population) move each tenday near the party and each month far away. minor: small events that happen on their own as time passes, near the party; each can be rerolled or undone later. Conditions: safetyBelow/Above, prosperityBelow/Above, settlements, seasons (words matched against the season name), trouble (an active trouble reaches the place). Effects add to the place's numbers; population is a percentage. Tokens: {place}, {name}, {name2}, {goods}, {church}, {trouble}. reputation: standing tiers (min value, price and pay changes in percent), scale (how much an outcome is worth per point of drama), and what solving a trouble earns. A minor card's econ makes the place short of (kind short) or rich in (kind plenty) a good for some days: good names it, otherwise {goods} is used, drawn from what the place needs (short) or makes (plenty). A minor card's tie (spouse, rival...) ties {name} and {name2} together when the DM makes one of them an NPC page; dies names the slot ({name}) of someone the event kills. A minor card's then: what it may lead to, each a followups (or minor) card id with after [min, max] days and a chance; the follow-up keeps the same people and goods. followups: cards that only happen that way. recurChance: how often a small event names one of the town's familiar strangers instead of someone new. drift.exodus: a place that stays below safetyBelow or prosperityBelow (or under a trouble or shortage) for months months in a row loses loss percent of its people, who go to the nearest place within refugeeMiles. Pages for NPCs never move.

thresholds.text: The roads around {place} are no longer safe, and people stop travelling after dark.
{place} feels safe again. The night watch is cut back and the gates stay open later.
Hard times in {place}: shops are shuttered and families are leaving.
{place} is booming. New houses are going up and prices are climbing.

exodus.text: Families are leaving {place} in numbers after months of {why}. Carts of belongings crowd the road to {to}.
exodus.alone: Families are leaving {place} in numbers after months of {why}, and the empty houses are being boarded up.
exodus.refugees: Refugees from {from} have come to {place}, and the {church} is struggling to feed them.

minor.name: A death in the community
minor.text: {name}, a well-known figure in {place}, has died after a long life. Everyone who could turned out for the funeral.
minor.dm: Their will leaves something to someone unexpected, and the family is already arguing.

minor.name: A fatal accident
minor.text: {name} of {place} was killed in an accident at work. The {church} is collecting for the family.
minor.dm: It may not have been an accident: {name2} was seen near the place just before.

minor.name: A wedding
minor.text: {name} and {name2} were married in {place}, and the feast went on until dawn.
minor.dm: One family is far from happy about it.

minor.name: A birth
minor.text: Twins were born to {name} of {place}, the first in years. The midwife calls it a good omen.

minor.name: A local feud
minor.text: {name} and {name2} of {place} have fallen out over a boundary stone, and their families no longer speak.
minor.dm: Either side would pay well for proof the other moved the stone.

minor.name: A tavern brawl
minor.text: A brawl in {place}'s busiest tavern left a dozen people hurt and the common room in pieces.
minor.dm: It was started deliberately, to cover a theft upstairs.

minor.name: A theft
minor.text: Thieves broke into {name}'s shop in {place} and made off with a season's takings.
minor.dm: The thief is someone the owner trusts.

minor.name: A shortage
minor.text: {place} has run short of {goods}. Prices have doubled and tempers are fraying.
minor.dm: A merchant is hoarding it to drive the price up.

minor.name: A glut
minor.text: A good season means {place} is awash with {goods}, and it is selling cheap.

minor.name: A caravan arrives
minor.text: A large caravan reached {place}, bringing {goods}, news from far away and a few strangers who mean to stay.
minor.dm: One of the strangers is running from something.

minor.name: A caravan is overdue
minor.text: The caravan from {place} is three days overdue, and families are gathering at the gate each evening.
minor.dm: It was ambushed on the road; some survivors are hiding nearby.

minor.name: A fire
minor.text: Fire gutted a row of houses in {place} before the bucket chain could stop it. No one died, but many are homeless.
minor.dm: Someone saw a figure running from the first house to burn.

minor.name: A flash flood
minor.text: Heavy rain sent a flood through the low ground of {place}, ruining stores of {goods}.

minor.name: A hard frost
minor.text: A hard frost has gripped {place}. The old and the poor are suffering, and firewood is scarce.

minor.name: A dry spell
minor.text: Weeks without rain have left the wells around {place} low and the fields brown.

minor.name: A sickness
minor.text: A coughing sickness is spreading in {place}. The {church} has opened its doors to the sick.
minor.dm: It started at the well near {name}'s house.

minor.name: A monster in the fields
minor.text: A monster spawned in the fields outside {place} and killed livestock before the watch drove it off.
minor.dm: It came back the next night, and the next.

minor.name: A local hero
minor.text: {name}, an Iron-rank adventurer from {place}, killed a monster that had been troubling the roads. Everyone is buying their drinks for a month.

minor.name: A victim of the trouble
minor.text: {trouble} claimed another victim near {place}: {name} went out and did not come back.
minor.dm: {name2} saw what happened and is too frightened to say.

minor.name: Families leave
minor.text: Several families have left {place} because of {trouble}, taking what they could carry.

minor.name: A militia forms
minor.text: The people of {place} have formed a militia under {name}, armed with whatever they could find.
minor.dm: {name} is enjoying the power more than they should.

minor.name: Bandits on the road
minor.text: Travellers on the road near {place} were robbed by masked riders.
minor.dm: The riders are locals, and the reeve knows it.

minor.name: Smugglers caught
minor.text: The watch in {place} caught smugglers moving {goods} by night.
minor.dm: The goods were only a cover. Something else was in the false bottoms.

minor.name: A family ruined
minor.text: {name}'s family in {place} lost everything to debt, and their house is to be sold.
minor.dm: The lender is one of the great houses, buying up the street quietly.

minor.name: A new business
minor.text: {name} has opened a new shop in {place}, selling {goods} at prices that undercut everyone.
minor.dm: The money behind it comes from somewhere shady.

minor.name: A new priest
minor.text: A new priest of the {church} has arrived in {place}, and their sermons are drawing crowds.
minor.dm: They were sent here to keep an eye on someone.

minor.name: A divine sign
minor.text: Folk in {place} swear the shrine of the {church} glowed at midnight. Pilgrims have started arriving.
minor.dm: It was an astral power passing close, not a god.

minor.name: A strange door
minor.text: Children near {place} found a shimmering door in an old ruin. The Adventure Society has put a guard on it.
minor.dm: It is a small astral space, ripe for a low-rank team.

minor.name: An odd stranger
minor.text: A stranger in odd clothes was found wandering near {place}, speaking a language no one knows.
minor.dm: They may be an outworlder, newly arrived.

minor.name: A festival scandal
minor.text: The last celebration in {place} ended in scandal when {name} was caught with {name2}'s spouse.

minor.name: A new headman
minor.text: {place} has a new headman: {name}, after the old one stepped down.
minor.dm: The old headman did not step down willingly.

minor.name: A council quarrel
minor.text: The council of {place} is deadlocked over new taxes on {goods}, and the merchants are threatening to leave.

minor.name: A fine harvest
minor.text: The harvest around {place} is the best in years, and the granaries are full.

minor.name: Crop blight
minor.text: A blight has struck the fields around {place}. Farmers are burning whole crops to stop it spreading.
minor.dm: It began where a monster core was buried.

minor.name: A missing child
minor.text: {name}'s youngest has gone missing in {place}. Search parties are out in the woods and fields.
minor.dm: The child is safe, and hiding something they found.

minor.name: The Society recruits
minor.text: An Adventure Society recruiter visited {place}, and three young people left with them for Iron-rank training.

tiers.name: Honoured
tiers.text: Doors open everywhere. Prices drop and the best contracts come to the party first.

tiers.name: Liked
tiers.text: People are glad to see the party and give them the benefit of the doubt.

tiers.name: Disliked
tiers.text: Prices go up, doors close, and some contracts go to other teams.

tiers.name: Hated
tiers.text: People refuse to deal with the party, and someone may come looking for them.

followups.name: The feud turns bloody
followups.text: The feud in {place} came to blows: {name} beat {name2} badly in the market square.
followups.dm: {name2}'s kin are talking about taking it further.

followups.name: A death in the feud
followups.text: {name2} died of the beating, and {name} has fled {place}.
followups.dm: {name} is hiding with relatives a day's ride away.

followups.name: A trial in the feud
followups.text: {name} stood before the elders of {place} for the beating of {name2}, and was fined heavily.
followups.dm: {name} blames {name2}'s family for every coin of it.

followups.name: The feud is settled
followups.text: {name} and {name2} shook hands before the {church}, and the boundary stone is back where it belongs.

followups.name: A child of the marriage
followups.text: {name} and {name2} of {place} have a newborn, and the whole street brought gifts.

followups.name: It was no accident
followups.text: The watch in {place} has arrested {name2} for the death of {name}. It was no accident after all.
followups.dm: {name2} swears someone paid them to look the other way.

followups.name: An inheritance quarrel
followups.text: {name}'s family in {place} is tearing itself apart over the estate, and {name2} has claimed a share no one expected.
followups.dm: {name2} has a will that may be forged.

followups.name: A riot
followups.text: A crowd in {place} broke into the stores when the {goods} ran out. The watch had to clear the streets.
followups.dm: Someone was handing out drink to the crowd beforehand.

followups.name: The watch cracks down
followups.text: After the riot, {place} has a curfew, and the watch is stopping anyone out after dark.

followups.name: Relief arrives
followups.text: Wagons of {goods} from a neighbouring town reached {place}, and the worst of the shortage is over.

followups.name: Hunger
followups.text: With the crops lost, families in {place} are going hungry, and the {church} is handing out bread.

followups.name: A fight at the well
followups.text: {name} and {name2} came to blows over the last good well in {place}.

followups.name: A search party
followups.text: {name2} led a search party out of {place} looking for {name}, and came back with nothing but a torn cloak.

followups.name: The missing child is found
followups.text: {name}'s youngest was found safe in an old barn outside {place}, cold and hungry but unharmed.
followups.dm: The child says a kind lady kept them company.

followups.name: No sign of the child
followups.text: The searches have stopped. There is still no sign of {name}'s youngest, and {place} has gone quiet.

followups.name: The thief is caught
followups.text: {name2} was caught in {place} trying to sell goods stolen from {name}'s shop.

followups.name: Bandits raid a farm
followups.text: The bandits near {place} have grown bold enough to raid a farm on the edge of town.

followups.name: The sickness spreads
followups.text: The sickness in {place} has spread to the next street, and the {church} has run out of beds.

followups.name: The sickness passes
followups.text: The sickness in {place} has passed. The {church} rang its bells for those it took.

followups.name: Rebuilding after the fire
followups.text: {name} is leading the rebuilding of the burned houses in {place}, and half the town has turned out to help.

followups.name: The fire was set
followups.text: Word in {place} is that the fire was set on purpose, and people are pointing at {name2}.
followups.dm: {name2} is innocent, and knows who did it.

followups.name: A shop war
followups.text: {name}'s new shop and {name2}'s old one are at war in {place}: price cuts, smashed windows and worse.

followups.name: A duel of honour
followups.text: {name2} challenged {name} to a duel over the festival scandal in {place}. Both walked away, barely.

followups.name: The caravan is lost
followups.text: Riders found the overdue caravan's wagons burned on the road from {place}. There is no sign of the drivers.

followups.name: The caravan limps in
followups.text: The overdue caravan reached {place} at last, short two wagons and with a story no one quite believes.

followups.name: A tax protest
followups.text: Merchants in {place} shut their shops for a day to protest the council's new taxes on {goods}.

followups.name: The monster returns
followups.text: The monster in the fields outside {place} is back, and this time it took a shepherd.

followups.name: The stranger vanishes
followups.text: The odd stranger found near {place} has vanished from the room the {church} gave them, leaving drawings no one understands.

followups.name: The militia clashes with the watch
followups.text: {name}'s militia and the watch of {place} came close to blows over who keeps the peace.

followups.name: A debt repaid in blood
followups.text: The moneylender who ruined {name}'s family was found beaten in an alley in {place}.
followups.dm: {name} did it, and their family is covering for them.

followups.name: The headman is challenged
followups.text: {name2} has called for {name} to step down as headman of {place}, and the town is taking sides.
